scripts.db:generate: docker compose --env-file apps/backend/.env.development exec backend npx drizzle-kit generate
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose --env-file apps/backend/.env.development exec backend npx drizzle-kit migrate
scripts.db:migrate:test: docker compose --env-file apps/backend/.env.development exec -e NODE_ENV=test backend npx drizzle-kit migrate
scripts.test:file: docker compose --env-file apps/backend/.env.development exec -e NODE_ENV=test backend npx vitest run
